department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants: May 1 for Fall (September) 2027 entry; August 1 for Winter.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT taken on/after 21 Jan 2026: 5 overall with at least 4.5 per section (older tests: 92 with 21 per section).
toefl_min.quote: For tests written on or after January 21, 2026: 5 with at least 4.5 in each section or equivalent | For tests written before January 21, 2026: 92 with at least 21 in each section or equivalent

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.0 overall with at least 6.0 in each band.
ielts_min.quote: an overall band score of 7.0 on IELTS with at least 6.0 on each band

supervisor.value: The ECE pages checked do not say whether a supervisor must agree before you apply.

funding.value: U of A guarantees every PhD student at least CAD 100,000 over years 1-4 and at least CAD 25,000 in year 1 (not sponsored or part-time students).
funding.quote: minimum guaranteed funding of $100K CAD over four years and not less than $25K CAD in their first year

entry_route.value: PhD minimum is an undergraduate degree with a 3.3/4 GPA, but the department describes initial admission to the MSc as the structured pathway; master's holders enter the PhD.
entry_route.quote: The Department’s minimum requirements for admission to the PhD program are an undergraduate degree with an admission GPA of at least of 3.3 on the 4-point scale

also.quote: Initial admission to the MSc program provides a structured pathway, requiring prescribed graduate-level coursework to validate comprehensive disciplinary proficiency prior to formal PhD candidacy.

notes: CV and three references required. Applicants who already hold a PhD in ECE or a related field are not admissible.
